settings.label: Enabled
settings.description: Show CHANNELS on the main menu.

settings.label: Manage Channels
settings.description: Add a channel, or rename, reorder and remove the ones you have.

settings.label: Media Folder
settings.description: Where local video lives. Folder channels only use files inside it.

settings.label: Weather Channel
settings.description: Put the weather station on the dial as a channel of its own.

settings.label: Guide Auto-Scroll
settings.description: Scroll the guide through the channel list on its own.

settings.label: Guide Resume After
settings.description: Idle seconds before the guide resumes scrolling by itself.

settings.label: Guide Music
settings.description: Play the Weather module's music over the guide. Needs its Music setting on.

settings.label: Channel Preview
settings.description: What to show of a channel while you pick one on the guide: the program playing, a picture of it, or nothing.

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: How loud everything on Channels plays — programs, the guide's music and its previews.

settings.label: Even Out Volume
settings.description: Keeps programs and adverts at a similar loudness. Costs a little processing on slower boards.

settings.label: Schedule Ahead
settings.description: How far ahead every channel is built. Topped up nightly and at startup.

settings.label: While Tuning
settings.description: What fills the screen while a channel loads.

settings.label: Channel Banner
settings.description: What the on-screen channel card shows, for how long, and where.

settings.label: Channel Logo
settings.description: A station mark flown in the corner while a channel is on air.

settings.label: Rebuild Schedules
settings.description: Rebuild every channel's schedule. Do this after adding video.
